event_summary: A hand holds a lit match while the visible flame changes size and shape and the match head becomes darker.
raw_event_description: The clip begins with a hand holding a pale matchstick horizontally, with a small bright flame at the match head and a partial matchbox-like object at the lower left. The flame becomes taller and more teardrop-shaped, with a bright yellow-white center and a faint bluish-purple edge near the lower side. The match head remains at the flame base and appears progressively darker. The hand continues gripping the matchstick, with small position changes of the hand and match in the frame. Near the end, the flame remains present above the darkened match head.

reasons: The matchstick, hand, and small flame are visible at the start.
The lower-left object is only partly visible.
The background is dark and provides little scene context.
